implementation_name: Frozen TRI OER second-family prediction and exploration implementation
outcome_status_at_freeze: four target fom buffers remain undecoded; target compositions, sources, matched controls, policies, and cards are hash-frozen
claim_guard: All four plate-level targets, methods, controls, and cards remain in the result. No plate, learner, source, or representation may be dropped based on target FOM.

target_join.procedure: After PREOUTCOME verification, decode fom only for plates 3496, 3851, 3860, and 4098 and join by frozen original_row.
target_join.validity: finite FOM only; no range trimming after reveal
target_join.direction: larger is better because FOM is negative overpotential

few_shot_design.independent_targets: each of the four composition sets is a separate target unit
few_shot_design.sampling: complete outcome-free composition clusters selected by SHA-256 order within the target plate
few_shot_design.evaluation: all unlabelled entities from the same plate
few_shot_design.primary_ood: highest quartile of nearest-selected-label distance recalculated from composition only within each repeat

representations.periodic_summary: weighted mean, standard deviation, minimum and maximum of atomic number, periodic group, period, Pauling electronegativity and covalent radius, plus stoichiometric entropy and element count

primary_prediction_family.primary_cell: n=30, ExtraTrees, element_fraction, dynamic target-plate OOD quartile 4
primary_prediction_family.replication_gate: same effect direction on at least three of four plates
primary_prediction_family.robustness: same direction in at least two learners and both representations; all cells retained
primary_prediction_family.multiplicity: Holm over four named primary contrasts

matched_specificity.source_skill: pre-frozen closest wrong-source grouped OOF Spearman match; report gap and do not call matched when gap exceeds 0.05
matched_specificity.capacity: five frozen random features, equal to five real source channels
matched_specificity.shuffle: one pre-frozen independent permutation per real source

exploration.top_component: top ceil(5 percent) composition clusters within each plate ranked by maximum FOM; median and mean are sensitivities
co_primary: acquisitions to first distinct top cluster
mandatory: unique components contributed by each source
exploration.multiplicity: Holm over CCA consensus versus random, novelty, same-reaction, best adjacent single, wrong, and shuffled policies

hypothesis_cards.test: paired FOM difference against every frozen OOD-distance-matched control with 10,000 paired swaps

inference.within_plate: paired repeat and composition-cluster bootstrap, 10,000 resamples
inference.across_plates: random-effects estimate over four plate-level effects with tau-squared and I-squared
inference.across_targets: random-effects synthesis of fixed Starrydata and TRI target-level effects; no seed interval is treated as dataset replication

compute.parallel_unit: plate x repeat x budget x learner x representation
compute.required_completion: input/design/sentinel hashes, all four plates, row arithmetic, finite predictions, method/policy/card completeness, and independent verifier
